title: Work folder status
description: Printed by `harness status <work_dir>` (nothing is written): where a work folder stands, recomputed from question-registry.json, answers.json, inventory.json and the producers' output documents, never from the possibly stale question documents. PER PRODUCER (intake, read-structure = registry producer 'structure', callouts, grid-system, reader = the drawing-reader agent's questions from harness ask): `questions` counts the registry entries that are not obsolete (`total`), those that block (`blocking`, an entry without a recorded blocking flag counts as blocking and in `blocking_unknown`: rerun its producer), `blocking_open` (blocking and no active answer) and `answered`; `stale_answers` lists the answers whose file changed or whose question is no longer raised; `outputs` says whether the producer's documents are fresh: read-structure, callouts and grid-system record the sha256 of the inventory.json they were built from (grid-system also the fingerprint of the answers it read) and are `stale` when it differs from the current one, `missing` when a document does not exist; `rerun` is the command that fixes it. GATE 1 READINESS (`gate1.ready_for_gate1`) is true only when `reasons` is empty: every probed DXF/DWG has an active units answer; grid systems exist, grid_system_select is answered and every system the project uses (the answer's `systems` value, else every system in grid-systems.json) is axis-assigned in grid-systems.json (by grid_family_axis_assignment answers; answering grid_system_axis_unassigned in words alone does not assign an axis); every raised, non-obsolete level_storey_selection and level_finished_vs_structural question is answered (the selected files are not recorded in a free-text answer, so every file that raises them counts); no blocking question is open in intake, read-structure, grid-system or reader; every producer's outputs are fresh (reader: n/a). Ready does not mean the Tekla grid is built: tekla_grid is null until units and X/Y are answered, and the engineer still confirms at gate 1. Not detected: a read-structure rerun that wiped structure/grid-systems/*.svg, and changed input files that intake has not re-read (status does not see the input folder).

inventory_sha256.description: sha256 of the current inventory.json bytes.

producers.description: intake, read-structure, callouts, grid-system, reader, in this order.

reasons.description: What still stops gate 1; empty exactly when ready_for_gate1 is true.

total.description: Registry entries of the producer that are not obsolete.

blocking.description: Of those, the blocking ones (including blocking_unknown).

blocking_unknown.description: Entries written before the registry recorded the blocking flag: counted as blocking; rerun the producer.

blocking_open.description: Blocking entries without an active answer.

answered.description: Entries with an active answer, blocking or not.

obsolete.description: Entries the producer no longer raises (not counted in total).

blocking_open_ids.description: The ids behind blocking_open, at most 50.

status.description: n/a: the reader produces no document from the inputs (its questions are raised one at a time by harness ask), so it has no freshness.

files.description: The documents checked, relative to the work folder.

reason.description: Why not fresh; null when fresh.

rerun.description: The command line that fixes it; null when fresh.
